name: Calmex
blurb: How to obtain Calmex — crafting recipe, ingredients, vendors and any world sources. Directions and photos are added by hand.

creatures.note: Around 75 creatures can drop Calmex as generic loot; they are not listed individually. See the Containers expand for the per-container drop rates and How to Obtain for the crafting recipe.

consumption.note: Calmex is a chem consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
